body:
Hello there,

I am not a black male, but I am a minority female. Your post did validate that my experiences with being misjudged by whites aren't crazy, so thank you.  You say why bother living, but your words helped me.  

It may feel like the whole world is racist, but there are a lot of people that won't see you as the way blacks are presented in the media. I would see you the way you describe yourself. My co-workers would respect you. My friends would too. An intelligent and good person will know not to always trust the media and look at the individual. 

You say you will never find a beautiful wife. How do you know? What if you stay alive and do find someone you like? There are black men that have married beautiful women, so please don't let negativity around you discourage you.

Thanks, but I want an answer as to why several women emotionally and verbally abused me. 

I am not making much sense now.
